item.title: Mini vMac v2.6
item.description:
Mini vMac 2.6 | minivmac4ios-2.6
* Added 512×384 variant of Mac II * Requires iOS 13.4 * Dropping 32-bit support (iOS 9) made the app smaller * Prefer pixel-perfect scaling when display scaling filter is set to nearest * Auto-hide iOS home indicator * Partially fix some command-key shortcuts going to iOS instead of the emulated Mac (#45) * ⌘-w and most others will get passed to the emulated machine if it's running * ⌘-q and ⌘-h don't seem interceptable, the app doesn't receive any key events for them, but ⌘-q doesn't do anything (or maybe it does in some other configuration?), and ⌘-h will take you to the home screen * visionOS support (only tested in simulator)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zydeco/minivmac4ios/compare/v2.5...v2.6
